strongest_angle: We demonstrate the new Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow integration with the Agent Toolkit for AWS, showing how AI agent skills handle authoring, debugging, testing, and environment upgrades.

key_facts.fact: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow integrates with the Agent Toolkit for AWS to provide built-in AI agent skills that author, debug, and test workflows.
The AWS Data Analytics plugin in the open-source Agent Toolkit for AWS provides skills following the open Agent Skills standard for Amazon MWAA.
Amazon MWAA enables upgrading environments using any AI coding assistant that supports agent skills like authoring-mwaa-workflow and debugging-mwaa-workflow.
Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow includes four specific skills named authoring-mwaa-workflow, debugging-mwaa-workflow, testing-mwaa-workflow, and upgrading-mwaa-workflow.

named_entities.name: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow
